title: 20-Year Treasury Bond auction (reopening)
source: TSY: treasury.gov tentative auction schedule PDF, text layer read directly 2026-09-01 — row reads verbatim '20-Year BOND R / Announcement Thursday, September 10, 2026 / Auction Tuesday, September 15, 2026 / Settlement Friday, September 18, 2026', 1:00pm ET
notes: Long-end supply the day before the Sep-16 FOMC — the auction that drew today's concession, reopened. Formal size/when-issued announcement is 2026-09-10, the same day as the 30Y reopening auction and the 10-20Y buyback operation and one day before CPI, which compresses the concession window into 09-10/09-11. Settles 09-18, quarterly OpEx day. An aggregator dating this sale to 09-17 was logged unresolved on 2026-08-29 and is refuted by the primary schedule above: 09-17 is the 10Y TIPS auction date.
